real_query.verdict: ALL 20 products are brake pads for Honda Civic Si. Every single one is a plausible answer to the query.
observations: Every product contains 'brake pads' and 'Honda Civic Si' in the title
Products repeat across ranks (Hawk Street 5.0 appears 7 times, Improved Coated 5 times, Cobalt Racing 3 times, EBC Yellowstuff 2 times)
Repetition suggests the same product listed by multiple merchants, or the same merchant with variant listings
The tail is NOT padding — it contains genuine low-relevance matches (same product class, same vehicle)
The ~300 boundary is the relevance threshold: the catalog exhausts its supply of brake pads for Honda Civic Si

nonsense_query.verdict: ALL 20 products are unrelated to the nonsense query. Bathroom products, wallets, bracelets, hoodies, sunscreen, keychains, calendars.
observations: No product contains any token from the nonsense query
Products repeat (Season 7 Hoodie 6 times, xHP TCU Flash 5 times, Statshy Wallet 2 times)
The nonsense tail is a stable default set of unrelated products (World B, 0.79 Jaccard)
This is the 'default' response when no products match — not random padding, but a fixed fallback set

comparison.real_query_tail: Genuine low-relevance matches — all brake pads for Honda Civic Si, repeating from multiple merchants
comparison.nonsense_query_tail: Unrelated products — bathroom, wallets, hoodies — a stable default fallback set
comparison.key_difference: Real query tail contains products that ARE plausible answers (same product class, same vehicle). Nonsense query tail contains products that are NOT answers at all.
comparison.conclusion: The real-query tail and nonsense-query tail are different mechanisms. The real-query tail contains genuine low-relevance matches from a stable candidate set. The ~300 boundary is the relevance threshold (DIRECTIVE-8-v2 §1 outcome), not a padding exhaustion point. 'Absent at depth' for a real query means absent from a stable, relevance-ordered, exhaustive 300-product set — this is a STRONG finding, close to a binary defect.
